Verse of the Day
For there is not a word in my tongue, but, lo, O Lord, thou knowest it altogether.
Psalm 139:4
Quote of the Day
"When callings change in ways that deeply impact you or your family, it can require great faith and trust in the Lord while you adjust."
Elder Patrick Kearon | 1 Apr 2026General Conference
